fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Connects TBO Chat (Chatwoot) to TBO Support. Chat conversations become tickets here; agent replies on those tickets are posted back to the chat.

fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: The number after /app/accounts/ in Chatwoot's address bar. Webhooks from other accounts are ignored.

fields.label: Bridge User Access Token
fields.description: Access token (Profile settings) of a Chatwoot administrator named e.g. "TBO Support". Used to read conversations, post agent replies and private notes, and resolve conversations.

fields.label: Agent Bot Access Token
fields.description: Access token of the Chatwoot Agent Bot "TBO AI". The AI's replies and hand-offs are posted as the bot. Leave empty to turn the AI off: bot-handled conversations then wait for a person.

fields.label: Webhooks
fields.description: Account webhook (Chatwoot Settings > Integrations > Webhooks): https://<this site>/api/method/helpdesk.api.chatwoot.account_webhook with Conversation Created, Conversation Status Changed, Conversation Updated and Message Created. Agent Bot webhook URL: https://<this site>/api/method/helpdesk.api.chatwoot.bot_webhook

fields.label: Account Webhook Secret
fields.description: The secret Chatwoot shows for the account webhook. Every delivery must carry a valid X-Chatwoot-Signature made with it, signed less than 5 minutes ago.

fields.label: Agent Bot Webhook Secret
fields.description: The Agent Bot's own webhook secret, which Chatwoot signs bot deliveries with. If you can't find it, leave this empty and add ?token=<Account Webhook Secret> to the bot's webhook URL instead.

fields.label: AI answers new chats first
fields.description: In inboxes with the TBO AI bot, the AI answers from the knowledge base, raises a ticket when the team is needed, and hands the chat to a person when asked or unsure. Off: new chats go straight to a person.

fields.label: AI replies before hand-off
fields.description: After this many AI replies in one chat, a person takes over.

fields.label: Hand-off Team ID
fields.description: Optional. The Chatwoot team (Settings > Teams, the number in its address) a chat is assigned to when the AI hands over.

fields.label: Customer for unknown contacts
fields.description: Optional. New chat contacts that match no existing contact or customer are added to this customer.

fields.label: Sign-in with Microsoft
fields.description: TBO Chat signs agents in through TBO Support, so Microsoft is the only way in (docs/chatwoot-sso.md).

fields.label: Sign in through TBO Support
fields.description: Open TBO Chat sends an active agent who is signed in here straight into TBO Chat. Needs the Platform App Token and the Bridge User Access Token.

fields.label: Platform App Token
fields.description: Access token of a Chatwoot Platform App (Super Admin console > Platform Apps). It signs agents in, adds new agents and removes people who leave.

fields.label: Add agents who aren't in TBO Chat yet
fields.description: Off: only people already in the Chatwoot account can open TBO Chat.

fields.label: Managers join as administrators
fields.description: New System Managers and Agent Managers get the administrator role. People already in TBO Chat keep their role.
